verbatim_quote.original: we need to configure mihomo to test all proxies in balance or other proxy groups with a https link a gstatic or even harder test it filter wrong proxies.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: We need to configure mihomo to test all proxies in balance and other proxy groups with an https link (gstatic or even a harder test) to filter out wrong proxies.

extracted_decision.summary: Configure mihomo to health-check every proxy in Auto, Load Balance, and Fallback with a strict https test and explicit expected-status so dead nodes are filtered out of rotation.
extracted_decision.rationale: Pinned destinations kept hitting dead nodes, and the checks lacked expected-status so they never discriminated health.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Health-checking all groups increases probe traffic.
